svg.aria-label: Eight designs in four families: shared memory, shared nothing, shared key-value store, and shared disk, each drawn as one or two stacks of application, SQL, access methods, cache and disk. Side-by-side boxes run on different nodes, spanning boxes are shared, and orange copies behind a box are replicas. Blue lines mark where nodes couple and what crosses; orange lines mark where data is copied and what is sent; dashed grey marks where concurrency control runs. In the deterministic design, Calvin, the orange line sits above the blue one: it copies its input log before it splits work among partitions.
svg.text: Where nodes couple, and where data is copied
Each family is named for what every node shares, and holds the designs that cut at that joint. Boxes side by side run on different nodes; a box spanning both is shared.
Blue: where nodes couple, and what crosses. Orange: where data is copied, and what each replica receives. Dashed grey: concurrency control.
